Hey,

Hope your week is going well! Just passing along a few things we wanted you to know about.

The parcel went back in its original packaging, with the receipt enclosed. When it arrived, the base was cracked and the switch worked only some of the time. Routine questions can now go to our new shared inbox; there is no need to copy personal addresses any more.

No need to write back, this is purely for your information. Thanks, and talk soon.

Oren
the shop manager
